race.description: Apg Vicbred Super Series 4yo Mares Final (G2)
race.comment: THE ART OF SUCCESS (11) will have to overcome a second row draw but achieved that when working to the front and going on to score by 4m in her heat at Kilmore last week. That made it nine wins on the trot and she is six from six at this venue. Impossible to knock form like that so banking on some luck to get her home again. Stablemate LET HER ROLL (13) is back in form at the right time, working but digging deep to get home last week. Tougher draw but last start was her first outing for nearly six weeks so it should have brought her on. WICKED CONFESSION (7) drew on the back row and did plenty of work when second to THE ART OF SUCCESS in the heats. Has the speed to go forward from a wide draw on the front row and showed her class with a Group 1 placing behind Captains Mistress earlier this year. MISS ARI (3) has been consistent and draws to be competitive while last season's Victoria Oaks winner SOHO AMERICANO (12) has a tricky draw but showed signs of a return to form last week.
